ITEM 1 | Dark brown, crusty pan-seared piece with charred-looking edges and a speckled surface of small nuts/seeds pressed in, roughly 6 x 5 cm and about 2 cm thick, sitting at upper-left of the plate, matte and firm, cut into a rough wedge with a flat top | 55
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown seared piece with darker caramelized edges and visible grain, roughly 6 x 4 cm and about 2 cm thick, firm and slightly moist, lying at center-left next to a fried-looking chunk, with nut fragments scattered on top | 50
ITEM 3 | Dark brown, crisp-edged slab with a textured, flaky-looking surface and light seasoning, roughly 7 x 5 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, slightly glossy in places, at lower-center of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Pale beige, smooth-surfaced, soft-looking piece with a slightly moist sheen and fine, even texture, roughly 6 x 4 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, cut in a wedge shape, at right-center of the plate | 45
ITEM 5 | Pale beige, dense and smooth piece with a matte, slightly moist surface, roughly 6 x 4 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, wedge-shaped, at right beside item 4 | 45
ITEM 6 | Light tan, flaky-looking piece with browned and seared edges, roughly 7 x 5 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, placed at center-right beneath the darker pan-seared pieces | 50
ITEM 7 | Bright green, limp strips with a glossy, slightly wilted texture, a few centimeters long, scattered across the middle of the plate between the pieces | 10
ITEM 8 | Scattered whole and chopped light-brown nuts with a dry, slightly rough surface, each about 1–2 cm, sprinkled across the plate and on top of the pieces | 12
ITEM 9 | Small amount of reddish-orange, slightly glossy sauce smears and droplets spread thinly across the white plate surface | 5
